description: This file defines a Flutter widget called ResetButton, which provides a customizable button for resetting or starting a new game, with styling that adapts based on the game state.

classes.name: ResetButton
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a button for resetting or starting a new game, with style changes depending on whether the game is over.
